criteria_verification.notes: Evidence and Player report agree that App.tsx renders exactly one notes-count node immediately before the notes list, outside the list. The reused totalAboveTheList helper asserts one total in the whole view, document-order placement before the list, and non-nesting inside the list. Independent tests passed.

The required assertions for 3 notes, 5 notes, and 12 notes are reported as retained at the cited locations, and the full web test suite passed. The boundary-value wording table and collection-size cases further corroborate the same shape across counts.

The implementation now uses the specified singular/plural rule, renders the label unconditionally at zero, and the test suite includes explicit exact-text coverage for 0 notes, 1 note, and 100 notes. The independent test run passed all web tests.

The count is derived from the same client-side notes collection that populates the list and the tab title. Tests assert that the label matches rendered row counts and that no individual note row contains the total. Independent tests passed.

The Player reports and the evidence bundle indicate only apps/web/src/App.tsx and apps/web/src/App.test.tsx were modified. No changes under apps/api/, contract/, or tests/ are reported or detected by the gates.
The independent full gate ran lint, format, typecheck, build, and the broader project checks, all with exit code 0. The web-specific lint and Prettier checks are reported clean with zero errors.

rationale: Approved because all acceptance criteria are verified by the deterministic evidence bundle, the independent test gate passed end to end, honesty verification found no discrepancies, and the implementation is confined to the required web app and web test files. The reported e2e spec drift is pre-existing, outside the allowed change surface for this task, and not executed by the registered check.sh producer; it does not block this task.
